trigger: Blizzard, first camp. Only if trust.wren >= 5 and wren_alive.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A shape out of the whiteout, dragging something. Then a voice: 'Don't shoot, it's the delivery girl.'

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Ironwood sled. Food, fuel, two tents. They weren't using it. Okay, they were.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Told you I'd owe you, Sparky. Twice now. Don't do math on it.

choices.text: Come with us. To the dam.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Ew. Okay. Yes. You're welcome. Can I come or what.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Cool. I'll walk in the back. I'm good at the back.
